title: Macaroni or Pasta Salad with Light Mayonnaise

content.title: About
content.content: Macaroni or pasta salad with light mayonnaise is a cold dish made from cooked pasta, fresh vegetables, and a dressing based on light mayonnaise (3694). It has a mild flavor, a light creamy texture, and works well as a side or a standalone meal for picnics or lunches.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Light mayonnaise contains less fat and calories than regular mayo, making the salad more diet‑friendly.
Pasta salads are popular in cooler climates as a refreshing summer dish.
Different pasta shapes (spirals, shells, penne) create interesting textural contrasts.
Adding fresh vegetables like cucumber, tomato, and bell pepper boosts the vitamin content.
The salad keeps well in the refrigerator for up to 3 days without losing flavor.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Pasta provides a quick source of energy through complex carbohydrates.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Light mayonnaise reduces the overall fat level, which is beneficial for cardiovascular health.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The vegetables add vitamin C, potassium, and folate to the dish.

items.title: Dietary fiber
items.content: Using whole‑grain pasta increases fiber, supporting digestive health.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Fresh vegetables raise the water content, helping maintain hydration.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Light mayonnaise often contains eggs; those with an egg allergy should choose an egg‑free version.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Prepared light mayo can be salty; people monitoring sodium intake should control the amount of dressing.

items.title: Bacterial growth
items.content: If left at room temperature for more than 2 hours, the salad can become a breeding ground for bacteria.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Traditional pasta contains gluten; gluten‑free alternatives are recommended for those with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the pasta salad chilled, either as a main dish or as a side to meat or fish. It is convenient for lunch boxes, picnics, and barbecues.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the salad in an airtight container in the refrigerator at 0–4 °C. If kept longer than 3 days, check for off‑odors or slimy texture; discard if any signs of spoilage appear.
